stem: What is the most accurate statement about progress stored only in the learner's browser?

choices.text: Komadrona can restore it from a server backup at any time.
It cannot be deleted once the learner finishes a quiz.
It may be lost if site data is cleared or the device is reset.
It becomes an official record of examination readiness.

rationale: Browser-stored progress remains on the device but can be deleted with site data, lost during a reset, or unavailable in private browsing. Komadrona has no central learner backup, so export and import are required recovery features.

distractorRationales.rationale: The Version 1 architecture intentionally avoids a central learner database or server-side score backup.
Browser storage remains under browser and device control and can be removed.
Local study data is private self-study information, not an official academic or licensure record.

sources.locator: Transparency, declared purpose, proportionality, and data-minimization principles
